specification.title: Matrix Snap Shortcut Modes
specification.goal: user shortcut for active Snap mode
specification.owner_rule: This L3 exclusively owns the described capability within its parent L2; any other menu/panel calls it through the parent service contract.

api_contract.input: Typed command/document/geometry data and any selection or builder parameters required by this feature.
api_contract.output: Validated operation result and observable document changes; never silently claim success.
api_contract.edge_cases: Invalid/empty geometry, cancellation and tolerance/pathological input must be handled explicitly.
api_contract.integration: Register one capability owner; adapters dispatch to owning kernel/domain service.

acceptance_tests_auto: Automated: valid input exercises “Matrix Snap Shortcut Modes” without panic, leaked handle or stale scene reference.
Automated: invalid, empty, or degenerate input yields an explicit error and leaves document state consistent.
Automated: geometry fixture checks BRep validity/tolerance/closedness or documented intentional open output.
acceptance_tests_manual: Manual gate M02: run OpenMatrix9 UI; perform “Matrix Snap Shortcut Modes”; observe preview/feedback and commit/cancel behavior.
A visible failure/warning must be shown for unsupported input; the command must never silently do nothing.
invariants: No `90-after` dependency for any M01–M09 deliverable.
No implementation may be assumed from QymCAD until source paths are checked.
Existing document IDs/layer flags/units/history remain consistent after operation.
No separate OCCT operation should be coded inside a Matrix toolbar/menu adapter.

proposed_fixture.algorithm_and_coverage: Hotkey route theo keyboard focus/collision map M01
proposed_fixture.tolerance_policy: Use document absolute tolerance of M01; do not guess at source pin; pixel threshold calibrated for DPR.

runtime_implementation.scope: E and M consume a command-running viewport shortcut for END and MID, setting SnapSettings.one_shot; the command editor retains focus until a viewport pick releases it.
remaining: Manual M02-UI review pending; no human sign-off is claimed.

standalone_verification_2026_10_22.acceptance: E selects END and M selects MID while a command runs; a focused command editor does not trigger the shortcut.

standalone_verification_2026_11_18.scope: Ctrl+Click in Looking Down starts Elevator. Side View accepts the height along the captured CPlane normal, and the viewport receives E for the next exact endpoint.

windows_end_shortcut_2026_11_18.scope: The standard native window confirmed idle E and E after a mouse-picked Line start. With the master off, a native click used the exact source endpoint. The live document contained two Lines and two Undo entries. Ctrl+Z and the Redo icon removed and restored the second Line.

windows_tab_and_escape_2026_11_18.scope: Windows Tab locked the horizontal Line direction in Looking Down and Perspective committed equal Y/Z coordinates. Raw input showed a release-only Escape on the idle attempt whose badge stayed active. A delivered Escape press canceled End, including with an active Line prompt retained.

workspace_keyboard_reference_sync_2026_1.scope: The installed and repository Workspace references follow the approved UI keyboard rule. Eight egui checks verify idle E, input focus, deferred point delivery, cancellation and transcript prompts.

windows_tab_with_free_click_control_2026.scope: Tab locks the horizontal Line preview away from the pointer. At the same endpoint pixel, the live model confirms identical start and end Y with Tab and a 5.107266 mm Y change without Tab. One Undo restores the exact source drawing in each trial.

physical_elevator_prompt_2026_11_18.scope: The user confirmed the physical Line icon, Ctrl+Click and typed Elevator workflow in Looking Down. Read-only live geometry verified Z=2 at the start, (9,10,8) at the end, and one additional Undo entry.

deferred_elevator_base_2026_11_18.scope: A queued End click retains Ctrl across worker completion and opens a focused Elevator height prompt at the source pole. Completing Line after a typed height produces one transaction with exact Undo and Redo.
